import numpy as np

def score_merge_static(distance_matrix, demands, capacity, i_idx, j_idx):
    d0i = distance_matrix[0, i_idx]
    d0j = distance_matrix[0, j_idx]
    dij = distance_matrix[i_idx, j_idx]
    sav = d0i + d0j - dij
    scale = np.maximum(np.mean(distance_matrix[0, 1:]), 1e-12)
    load_frac = (demands[i_idx] + demands[j_idx]) / max(float(capacity), 1e-12)
    return (sav / scale) + 0.08 * load_frac
